UNFIXED FINDINGS (no separate items filed; owner decides): (a) 1_v8 ORDER_DIFFERS in all 5 runs: the QUALIFY elimination renders SELECT ... FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ..., COUNT(*) OVER (...) AS _w FROM lineitem WHERE ... ORDER BY l_returnflag, l_linestatus) AS _t WHERE _w > 0; the ORDER BY is only inside the derived table, so output order is undefined and PrestoDB returns N/F before A/F. Rendering verified independently. Suspected: the fork's QUALIFY elimination for the Presto generator should hoist the ORDER BY; likely also Trino and Athena (not run). (b) 15_v1, 15_v4, 15_v7, 15_v10 returned 0 rows against 1 on the first run; canonical Q15 also returns a row in only 9 of 20 further runs: exact equality between independently summed DOUBLE values; summation order varies (inferred, not traced); BenchBox's DECIMAL schema not exercised.
